integrity: Six substantive scientific files plus two reproducible Python programs and exact outputs; no claim of external verification.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns inclusion-minimal total domination only, not all total dominating sets or higher-rank Johnson graphs. Published 2026 work already gives the scalar minimum total domination number. The 2026 article was available through its abstract but not full text, so an equivalent all-minimal classification may exist there or in other unindexed sources. Finite computations independently cross-check small cases but universal proof is structural.
title: Minimal total domination in triangular graphs: short-legged spider forests
